assets.prompt: Draw a production pixel-art orchard tree GROWTH SHEET for an isometric fantasy farming game. An elegant PEAR tree with an upright tapered crown, a graceful branched trunk, slightly narrower than apple but full and lush. Fruiting version has 6-8 clearly pear-shaped golden yellow pears with small stalks, legible silhouettes. EXACTLY THREE isolated poses in ONE ROW and THREE equal rectangular cells, no drawn grid. LEFT: small young sapling with visible trunk and 2-3 leaf sprigs, about 35% of adult height. MIDDLE: fully grown lush tree with NO FRUIT. RIGHT: exact same grown tree with fruit added, preserve its crown outline, trunk and branch geometry. Roots sit at the SAME BASELINE 77% down each cell. Each logical cell 128x144 pixels, adult crown around 94x104 pixels, generous transparent margins, no clipping. TOTAL sheet aspect ratio 8:3. Match style reference: hand-crafted chunky PIXEL ART, dark aubergine outlines, organic but readable large flat clusters, only 3 tones in leaves (#24483F #3F6A45 #71934B), warm brown trunk with 3 tones (#4A3042 #735044 #A57554), restrained highlights #B0BD67. Beautiful lively silhouettes, visible trunk forks, strong light from upper left, 2:1 isometric game feel. NOT a generic oval lollipop crown, NOT a noisy dithered texture, NOT a flat triangular blob. NO smooth shading, antialiasing, gradients, photo texture, bloom, loose leaves or disconnected props. No soil tile, ground rectangle, cast shadow, pot, bench, ornaments, lettering, labels or background. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. All parts of each pose connected; fruit touches foliage. Fine craft comes from thoughtful shapes, not tiny speckled detail. The reference tree is only a style/quality reference; do NOT copy its willow shape.
